title: General Provident Fund (Central Services) Rules, 1960 — amendment of Rules 7, 8 and 10 (₹5 lakh annual subscription ceiling), 2022
department: Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare
sourceNote: Official (DoPPW/DoPT). The official 2022 DoPPW/DoPT OM confirms the GPF Rules were originally issued through S.O. 3000 dated 01.12.1960 and records the 2022 amendments to Rules 7, 8 and 10, including the Rs.5 lakh annual subscription ceiling. This PDF is the official amendment/implementation document, not a consolidated reproduction of the entire 1960 Rules.

title: Central Civil Services (Leave Travel Concession) Rules, 1988
titleHi: केन्द्रीय सिविल सेवा (अवकाश यात्रा रियायत) नियम, 1988
edition: 1988; official DoPT Rules notification with subsequent DoPT amendments/relaxations
sourceNote: Official (DoPT). This is the original official notification promulgating the CCS (LTC) Rules, 1988. DoPT's later annual report confirms subsequent LTC relaxations and amendments, so this should be retained as the foundational Rules document rather than treated as a consolidated 2026 compilation.

title: CCS (Leave Travel Concession) Rules, 1988 — Current DoPT Instructions and Relaxations
titleHi: केन्द्रीय सिविल सेवा (अवकाश यात्रा रियायत) नियम, 1988 — वर्तमान डीओपीटी निर्देश एवं शिथिलीकरण
sourceNote: Official (DoPT). The 11 October 2022 OM extended the special air-travel dispensation for NER, J&K, Ladakh and A&N up to 25 September 2024. It is an important subsequent instruction under the 1988 Rules, but is not itself a replacement for the Rules.
